hero.tagline: From the void to infinity: a project for learning, imagining and playing.
hero.subtitle: Your present is already your future: you just have to keep defining it.

story.body: VoidToInfinite is a project where learning meets imagination and play drives progress. I explore ideas, build meaningful skills and turn curiosity into experiences that can be shared with others.
story.support: Infinity is everywhere, but it is knowledge that brings it into reality.
story.figureAlt: Celestial figure offering an open palm
story.sceneAlt: Celestial figure holding a core of light at chest height, ringed by orbital arcs inside a violet nebula

learn.title: Learn with purpose
learn.body: Knowledge that inspires understanding and opens new possibilities.
learn.inspiration: Start with a question that unsettles you. Follow it even when it leads somewhere else. What you learn this way does not fade. It stays, and it changes how you see the next thing.

create.title: Create with clarity
create.body: Ideas become meaningful when they can be explored, built and shared.
create.inspiration: A vague idea cannot defend itself. Build it, shape it, show it to someone. The moment it exists outside your head, it starts getting better. So do you.

grow.title: Grow together
grow.body: Learning becomes infinite when knowledge moves between people.
grow.inspiration: Nobody gets far explaining things only to themselves. Say what you know, even if it feels small. Someone needed it today. Tomorrow you will be the one who needs it.

practice.title: Practice makes it real
practice.body: Knowledge only becomes yours once you try it: stumbles, redos and all.
practice.inspiration: Read less, try more. Break something on purpose and fix it. A mistake you understand beats an answer you copied. That is where knowledge becomes yours.

journey.title: Your journey has no final step.
journey.body: Every discovery creates a new question. Every skill opens another path. The journey continues as long as curiosity remains.
journey.quote: The destination is not infinity. The journey is.
journey.figureAlt: Celestial figure pointing upward with an index finger
journey.sceneAlt: Celestial figure with open arms at the end of a winding trail of light that passes through a row of arches

discover.label: Discover
discover.body: Explore ideas, ask questions and observe the world differently.

learn.label: Learn
learn.body: Build knowledge, develop understanding and shape your perspective.

imagine.label: Imagine
imagine.body: Connect ideas and discover possibilities that do not exist yet.

create.label: Create
create.body: Transform your thinking into something visible, useful or meaningful.

share.label: Share
share.body: Open your work to feedback, collaboration and new interpretations.

evolve.label: Evolve
evolve.body: Keep learning, redefining and expanding what is possible.

features.title: Three ways to keep moving.
features.intro: Learning, imagination and gaming are the same curiosity seen from three angles. Each one gives you a different way to turn what you know into something real.

learning.title: Learning
learning.body: Every expert was once a beginner. Learn at your own pace, follow the questions that matter to you, and watch small steps become real understanding.

bullets.one: Follow the question, not the syllabus
bullets.two: Build something, don't just read about it
bullets.three: Move slowly and keep hold of the thread
bullets.four: Stop when you need to, owing nothing

learning.figureAlt: Celestial figure studying a holographic tablet

imagination.title: Imagination
imagination.body: Your ideas deserve a place to live. Turn “what if” into something real you can share.

bullets.one: Try things where mistakes stay cheap
bullets.two: Put together what didn't arrive together
bullets.three: Get the idea out of your head early

imagination.figureAlt: Celestial figure thinking with a radiant heart

gaming.title: Gaming
gaming.body: Play is how we learn best. Compete, collaborate and celebrate every win, big or small.

bullets.one: Look for what you can't do yet
bullets.two: Compete without it stopping being play
bullets.three: Play with company whenever you can
bullets.four: Celebrate what you managed, however small

gaming.figureAlt: Celestial figure raising a golden star trophy

features.sceneAlt: Star-filled celestial figure holding a point of light in an open palm, ringed by an orbit of discs bearing the learn, imagine and play icons

about.title: What is VoidToInfinite?
about.what: VoidToInfinite is a personal creative project by Daniel Mosquera. It starts from a simple idea: anything can begin with a blank page.
about.approach: It is about learning and experimenting with design and technology without chasing a finished result. The interesting part is seeing how far an idea can go when you work on it step by step.
about.sdk: Its centrepiece is the System Design Kit, a design system being built from scratch. The components are only one part. The other is the process: deciding, testing, getting it wrong and fixing it until the pieces fit together and can be reused. VoidToInfinite documents that journey, from the void to whatever comes next.
about.status: It is not a company or a finished product, and it will keep changing for as long as there is something left to learn.
about.proof: This website is built on the same principle and respects the people who visit it: no analytics, no tracking, and not a single request to a third party.
